diagnostics.message: "gh" is a worker command and cannot be blocked
diagnostics.consequence: The executor needs this command to run a Ticket; upstream rejects the whole configuration instead of silently ignoring it.

diagnostics.message: accept mode is "off" but 1 rule(s) are enabled
diagnostics.consequence: Inferred candidates are never created in off mode, so proactive rules cannot accept anything; only explicit requests start work.
diagnostics.hint: Use "observe" while reviewing Decisions, or set mode to "auto" once the rules are trusted.

diagnostics.consequence: No new work starts while paused; the rest of the Policy is inert until someone resumes it.
diagnostics.hint: Check this is intentional before comparing two Policy versions or handing the file to someone else.

diagnostics.message: anyone in this scope can make an explicit request by mentioning the agent
diagnostics.consequence: The allowed list stops protecting this scope: an unlisted sender becomes an explicit request, works in every accept mode, and can start a Ticket.
diagnostics.hint: Keep "explicit" only for a dedicated support chat you actually want open to everyone; otherwise use "inferred" or "ignore".
